plan.notes: Source: official Notre Dame Department of Computer Science & Engineering 'CSE Undergraduate Handbook 2025-2026' (cse.nd.edu), section 2.7 'CS course plan for entering fall 2024 and beyond' (sample term-by-term plan), plus section 'CS program requirements for entering fall 2024 and beyond' for elective rules. Transcription method: downloaded the official PDF 2026-09-30 and transcribed the sample plan table verbatim (course codes, titles, credits). Caveats: (1) This is the department's sample sequence, not a per-student degree audit; students place into different first-year courses. (2) 'CSE Elective' slots = 18 credits chosen from 30+ CSE/EE courses (up to 9 EE); at least one must carry the CS Major Project attribute. (3) 'Technical Elective' slots = 9 credits from College of Engineering/College of Science courses. (4) 'Core Curriculum Course' slots = University Core Curriculum requirements (26 credits; Liberal Arts 1-3 covered by required Engineering/CSE courses; seminars can double count). (5) Course prereqs are NOT listed in the source plan table, so prereq arrays are left empty — do not infer them. (6) Minimum degree total per handbook is 126.5 credits (the plan's own 'Total credit hours 126.5'). Degree title 'BS CS' per handbook section heading 'To earn the BS CS'.
